replayr: parsers for emulator movie ("input log") files

replayr-package.Rd

Readers for emulator input recordings used in tool-assisted speedrunning. S3 outputs contain compact logical controller states, stable control identities, source numeric channels, metadata, and commands. Rows follow each format's frames, controller polls, timestamped events, or game tics. Unassigned controller ports and heterogeneous device observations use a replayr_poll_stream. read_movie() dispatches to the appropriate reader. movie_members() lists movies in a downloaded ZIP archive.

Quick start


  library(replayr)
  path <- system.file("extdata", "sample.fm2", package = "replayr")
  mv <- read_movie(path)
  n_frames(mv)                       # observation count
  press_counts(mv)                   # per-button active-observation counts
  p1 <- player(mv, 1L)               # logical matrix, observations x controls

Controller layout

Each movie uses compact columns. button_layout() maps local columns to stable control identities. Use align_buttons() for an explicit common matrix layout across controllers. Original numeric values are returned by analog_channels(); selected stick representations by stick_channels(). BK2 N64 Boolean stick overrides are retained in movie$stick_overrides (right, up, left, down per player) and applied using the recording's BizHawk version when computing stick angles and directions.
